title: projects:open refuses by throwing, so the remote screen reads Electron's invoke prefix
notes: src/main.ts:570 throws "Type the folder's path on the host" from a table.handle handler. ipcMain.handle rewrites the rejection as "Error invoking remote method 'projects:open': Error: ...", so that is the text the remote screen shows. Return the refusal as a value the way pdf:read does ({ refused }) and throw only for real failures. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/129 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/125#discussion_r4433727992
